atlases.prompt: A square sprite sheet for CosyWorld's ancient Greek drama narrative game. Realistic finely brushed MATTE OIL-PAINTED full body characters, worn fabric, believable adult faces and proportions, historical-mythic antique clothing, unique silhouettes, rich dark earth and bronze alongside each assigned accent color, softly directional neutral light, like high-end painted game standees. cells.design: Broad, square-set farmer with an uneven pepper beard, rolled clay-red sleeves and a charcoal hem. A crooked half-smile and one open palm make him look mid-bargain.
Long, lean traveler with a close-cropped beard, a tall eggshell felt cap and a salt-stiff lapis cloak. His free hand spreads low over an ordinary sample pouch.
Soft, round household patriarch with white curls and heavy lids, enveloped by an ample saffron mantle. His chin projects and one eyebrow lifts at the sound of a compliment.
A compact street vendor with a shaven scalp, an indigo apron folded diagonally across the chest and dust-red bands at the wrists. He has a wide, quick grin and stands with elbows akimbo.
Wiry, stooped farmer with flyaway white hair, a frayed brown shoulder throw and one crooked eyebrow. His fingers count against his palm while his eyes search for a way out.
Tall, erect horse dealer with a narrow black mustache, a high ochre collar and a geometric rust-and-cream shoulder panel. A folded lead rein at the hip suggests his trade.
Spare old juror who leans forward like a hook, with a sharp nose, white chin tuft and a near-black mantle slashed with ochre. His raised thumb and forefinger are poised to count a vote.
Relaxed adult son with a woolly dark crop, a long, soft umber-and-sage mantle and hands spread in a calming gesture. Carry his father's nose shape into an otherwise open, rounded profile.
Sun-browned vintner with a barrel chest, short work tunic and an olive shoulder sash patterned with vine tendrils. His knees bend and his weight drops as if testing a heavy pull.
Youthful, straight-backed god with shining black curls, a flat traveler’s hat with a brass wing brooch and a short pale mantle. He holds his hand out lightly, amused and expectant.
Sharp-cheeked civic schemer in a wedge-shaped fox-red cloak with a narrow cream lining. His chin and index finger point along the same imagined line of construction.
Straight-backed organizer with one thick dark braid across her crown and a dark plum mantle pinned high on a single shoulder. Her upright palm and steady gaze are enough to halt a delegation.
Tall, athletic Spartan with cropped curls and a pale clay peplos pinned high, crossed by a broad madder stripe. Plant both feet and have her beckon with a low, practical gesture.
Stately festival speaker with braided gray loops at her temples, a chalk linen mantle and a wide pomegranate-red collar. One level palm offers the floor to the next speaker.
Long-limbed, balding kinsman in a muted fig cloak with fresh shaving nicks and a pin left crooked on one shoulder. A sidelong, rueful look carries the joke about the failed disguise.
Heavy-browed dead poet with a block-cut gray beard and a broad ash-black mantle edged in tarnished gold. He plants his feet square and measures a line of verse with a fist.
Slender dead poet with a high bald crown, fine forked beard and a rippling blue-gray drape. Two raised fingers and a skeptical tilt set his argument in motion.
Intent speaker with dark cropped hair under a tawny cap, a dense slate cloak cut in a broad triangle and a bright green wool pin. Her hand opens toward the gathering as she addresses it.
Deep-chested neighbor with a grizzled fringe, ecru sleeves rolled to different heights and a rust-red shoulder wrap. His weight tips toward the plain grain sack balanced over one shoulder.
Lank grain farmer with a deep widow’s peak, tan face and bar-shaped green patches on a dull flax tunic. He cups his empty hands as if ready to walk the rows sowing.
Trim informer with a needle-point beard, angular brows and a purple-black mantle folded into a tight vertical pleat. A stylus behind his ear sits high enough to read on the card.
Weathered, heavyset harbor pilot with a shorn gray beard, a broad undyed felt hat and a sea-green cloak fastened with a large bronze ring. His thumb hooks back toward the quay.
Lithe mooring pilot with windblown silver temples, a triangular indigo shoulder wrap with an ivory wave stripe and a flat chart case tucked high against the ribs. He points out across the bay.

delphi.prompt: Original Ancient Greek narrative card game portrait asset production. Make one TRANSPARENT ALPHA sprite atlas with exactly six separated full-body standees in a perfectly regular 3 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid. Square sheet aspect 1:1. Each equal cell is portrait 2:3. Respect the grid exactly and keep ALL painted pixels within the central 78% of width and 86% of height of their own specified cell. The feet align on a full-body baseline at 90% cell height and the head is well below top of cell. Entire sandal and fingertips visible, complete bodies in standing relaxed three-quarter view. Transparent alleys between figures, transparent above heads, below feet, behind figures, between legs. No cast shadows or horizon, no stage, no gradients or scenery or backgrounds, no checkerboard paint, no writing, no lettering, no index marks, no frames. All figures are adults, rendered with painterly realism in richly tactile old-master matte oil and sun-baked Mediterranean colors, warm soft lateral light, clear individually distinct silhouettes, fine wool and bronze. The given reference sets painting style, with two explicit face and costume matches if in the prompt. The final asset contains six people and only those people. Strict reading order. TOP LEFT the Pythia from the approved concept image: older angular Mediterranean face, broad white linen crest, a single vertical laurel sprig beside her face, long dark charcoal mantle. TOP CENTRE Creusa exactly like the approved concept: middle-aged woman, braided black hair, deep madder cloak, amber clasps, folded cream embroidered cloth. TOP RIGHT Pylades, young traveler with dark close beard, boxy worn brown leather shoulder cape, low gray-blue wrap, standing a little contrapposto. BOTTOM LEFT Tyndareus, firm compact older king, square cropped white beard, heavy dark-bronze shoulder guards, faded-red narrow mantle, straight posture close-set feet. BOTTOM CENTRE Cadmus, stooping reed-thin old man, loose white hair, faded grape-brown drape gathered low, leafy thyrsus close to one shoulder. BOTTOM RIGHT Pentheus, upright young ruler, close-tied black curls, short angular vermilion mantle sharply pinned to one shoulder above warm cream tunic, feet firmly apart, chin forward.
